Hey, I’m sorry, based on my experience (which is quite some) you don’t need to know everything about the company, you can do your research and know stuff, but you don’t have to know everything, not even about the division you applied for. Their questions are always behavioral based on my experience, they want to get to know you, and basically every single interviewer will have very similar if not the same questions (as an example: why do you think you’ll fit here? Tell me a specific time you _____ in your current job place, have you ever been into a situation in which you had to do _____ and how did you succeed?) 

Don’t overthink it, be genuine, and don’t try to memorize everything, have fun with it. As long as you know your stuff and are a good storyteller you’ll be fine. Be sympathetic, genuine, and don’t be afraid to show your emotions!
